## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: mode-detect.sh one-line read-config.sh dso.workflow lookup; legacy detection removed (GREEN phase)

## Implementation
Rewrite `plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh` to:
1. Resolve CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (or use BASH_SOURCE fallback matching `skip-review-check.sh` pattern)
2. Call `bash "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null` to get the value
3. Output the value directly (defaulting to `local` if empty)
4. Remove `_enforcement`, `_merge`, `_remote` variables and the three-condition compound check
5. Remove the git-remote check entirely (remote detection moves to onboarding at write-time per epic design)
6. Preserve `DSO_CONFIG_PATH` → translate to `WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE` for read-config.sh test isolation

New implementation (pseudocode):
```bash
# Resolve plugin root
_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$_SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)}"

# Support DSO_CONFIG_PATH override for testing (translate to WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE)
if [[ -n "${DSO_CONFIG_PATH:-}" ]]; then
    export WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$DSO_CONFIG_PATH"
fi

_workflow=$(bash "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "${_workflow:-local}"
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] mode-detect.sh no longer contains grep for `enforcement.strategy` or `merge.strategy`
  Verify: ! grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy\|merge\.strategy' plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh
- [ ] mode-detect.sh no longer contains git remote get-url logic
  Verify: ! grep -q 'remote get-url' plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh
- [ ] mode-detect.sh calls read-config.sh dso.workflow
  Verify: grep -q 'read-config.sh.*dso\.workflow\|dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh
- [ ] mode-detect.sh outputs ci-pr given dso.workflow=ci-pr fixture
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=$(mktemp) && echo 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' > "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE" && out=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh 2>/dev/null) && rm -f "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE" && test "$out" = "ci-pr"
- [ ] mode-detect.sh outputs local when no config
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=/tmp/nonexistent-dso-cfg-$$-test out=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh 2>/dev/null); test "$out" = "local"
- [ ] RED marker removed from .test-index for mode-detect tests
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_mode_detect_reads_dso_workflow' .test-index || grep -v '\[test_mode_detect' .test-index | grep 'mode-detect.sh'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement mode-detect.sh: replace legacy two-key detection with read-config.sh dso.workflow lookup
